cost.limitation: Same-day weekend list-price estimate, not a bill. Other dates or missing cache components remain unknown. Reasoning is included in completion; never charged twice.

definitions.mechanical: Completed row with schema-valid answer, trace and no final validation errors. Pending cells remain in planned denominator.
definitions.schema: Pydantic structure only; parseable length-truncated JSON can be schema-valid but not deliverable. No-response cells are N/A, separately retained as incomplete.
definitions.quotes: Known ID and source text match (including logged deterministic source-span restoration), not semantic entailment.
definitions.repair: Actually budget-counted repair calls; successful means final mechanical completion, not semantic correctness.
definitions.latency: End-to-end recorded cell duration; all recorded outcomes, including failures. P50/P95 linear interpolation at (n-1)*p.
definitions.intervals: 95% Wilson describes input rounds only. Paired deltas additionally use whole-groupId cluster bootstrap (seed 1729, 2000 resamples); fewer than two groups has no interval. Neither quotes nor related turns are treated as independent groups.
definitions.pairing: Same stage/split/config/version/case/input hash; terminal outcomes only. Right minus left. Continuous self-generated histories excluded.
definitions.scopes: No pooled production success rate across stages or arms. Accounting total alone spans all recorded experiments.
